t.why: Heavy Chinese investment and aid make it one of China's closest partners. It clashed with Thailand on their border in 2025.
t.rel: Close to China, it has drawn heavy Chinese investment in ports and roads. It has a long-standing dispute with Thailand over temple areas on the border, and the two clashed militarily there in 2025.
t.know: Under the Khmer Rouge in the 1970s, about a quarter of the population died.
t.etext: It makes clothing, shoes and travel bags for the United States and Europe. Angkor Wat tourism and rice exports are big too. The US dollar is widely used alongside the national currency.
